predecessors.name: Jolof Empire
predecessors.text: Cayor: the Thiès region and the Cap-Vert peninsula round the capital Mboul (the page gives no outline; the same land the jolof-empire dossier loses to Cayor in 1549)

successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Cayor: the Thiès region and the Cap-Vert peninsula round the capital Mboul (the page gives no outline; the same land the jolof-empire dossier loses to Cayor in 1549)

ledger.x: 1549: Cayor and Baol are ruled together.
6 October 1886: Cayor falls to the French.
1886: the kingdom of Cayor ends and is divided into provinces under Demba War Sall's family, under French rule.

wars.name: French conquest of Cayor
wars.outcome: The French governor Faidherbe encouraged a clerics' rebellion in 1859, the French invaded in 1861 after Lat Jor broke a railway treaty; Lat Jor reigned 1862-1863 and 1871-1872 (the page's own dates for his second reign), took refuge with Maba Diakhou Ba of…

wars.name: Battle of Danki
wars.outcome: Cayor defeated Jolof near Lake Danki; Jolof invaded several times afterwards and was defeated.
